name: Range Breakout
summary: This EA identifies a defined price range (consolidation period) and places pending orders or enters market orders when price breaks out above or below that range. It is a classic range breakout strategy that aims to capture momentum moves following periods of low volatility and price compression.
summary_zh: 该EA识别一段明确的价格区间（盘整期），当价格突破该区间上轨或下轨时进场交易。这是一个经典的区间突破策略，旨在捕捉低波动率和价格压缩后的动量行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于区间突破，EA首先在指定的时间窗口内计算价格的高低点形成交易区间。入场条件是当价格突破区间上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，利用突破后的动量延续获利。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，或当价格重新回到区间内部时止损出场。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户风险的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓限制和每日亏损限制等保护机制，但具体实现取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于趋势启动初期的捕捉策略，但在假突破频繁的市场环境中表现不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on range breakout, where the EA first calculates the high and low of price over a specified time window to form a trading range. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the range high and a sell when price breaks below the range low, capitalizing on momentum continuation after the breakout. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or a stop-out when price re-enters the range, invalidating the breakout signal. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account risk percentage. Money management may include maximum position limits and daily loss caps, though the specific implementation depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and belongs to the early trend-capture category, but it tends to underperform in markets with frequent false breakouts.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和验证
区间突破是经典且经过长期验证的交易理念，在趋势市场中表现良好
通过时间窗口定义区间，避免了全天候交易的风险，减少无效信号
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic that is easy to understand and verify
Range breakout is a classic and well-tested trading concept that performs well in trending markets
Defining the range by time window avoids around-the-clock trading risk and reduces false signals
cons: 假突破是主要风险，价格短暂突破后回落会导致频繁止损
缺少波动率过滤机制，在低波动震荡市中容易产生过多无效交易
固定止盈止损可能不适应不同市场波动环境，缺乏自适应调整能力
cons_en: False breakouts are the primary risk, as price briefly breaks out then reverses, causing frequent stop-loss hits
Lacks a volatility filter mechanism, which can generate excessive invalid trades in low-volatility choppy markets
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss may not adapt well to different market volatility regimes, lacking self-adaptive adjustment
improvements: 增加ATR或波动率过滤，仅在波动率收缩后突破时入场，提高突破有效性
引入突破确认机制，如要求收盘价突破或成交量确认，减少假突破损失
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility filtering to only enter on breakouts after volatility contraction, improving breakout validity
Introduce breakout confirmation mechanisms such as requiring close-price breakout or volume confirmation to reduce false breakout losses

risk_points: 假突破导致连续止损的风险较高，尤其在震荡行情中
缺少对交易时段和点差的过滤，可能在流动性差或点差大的时段产生不利入场
risk_points_en: High risk of consecutive stop-losses from false breakouts, especially in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks trading session and spread filtering, which may lead to unfavorable entries during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
